Ph.D. Guide
A multidisciplinary university, where ideas contaminate each other, through the comparison between people.
A university that sees in the strength of its research a globally recognized value.
An educational institution rooted in a beautiful territory, all to be discovered. This is the University of Padova
This "Guide to the PhD" is proposed as an agile tool to orient oneself and be able to live, to the fullest, one's "PhD experience".
